subject: Partner-led demo / technical deep-dive - scheduling
messages:
From: Anjali Singh <anjali@gsipartner.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Partner-led demo / technical deep-dive - next steps

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the time today - really appreciated the quick overview of Redwood and how it might fit in our Marketplace integrations. As discussed, our marketplace engineering team would like to jump into a technical deep-dive/demo with your SE to validate integration points and runtime requirements.

Suggested agenda (30-60m):
- High-level architecture & deployment modes (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private)
- Authentication / key management and marketplace billing flow
- Latency & throughput expectations for typical workloads
- Integration checklist and required artifacts

Possible windows next week (PT):
- Tue 2/24 10:00 - 11:00
- Wed 2/25 14:00 - 15:00
- Thu 2/26 09:00 - 10:00

Can you confirm who from Redwood should attend (SE + AE)? We can invite our Marketplace lead (Ethan Hughes) and GSI technical lead (Priya Raman) as well. I'm attaching a short partner capabilities deck for context.

If any of those slots don't work, please propose alternatives and we'll align.

Thanks,
Anjali
Anjali Singh | Partnerships Manager
Nimbus Cloud Marketplace
Attachment: partner-capabilities.pdf

Subject: Re: Partner-led demo / technical deep-dive - next steps

Hi Anjali - great to meet you earlier. Appreciate the clear agenda and suggested windows. Mateo (CC'd) is the AE on this motion and will help on commercial/next-step items.

We can join the technical deep-dive. Our recommended attendees from Redwood:
- Marissa Cole (Solutions Engineer)
- Mateo Alvarez (AE)
- Redwood SE (I'll lead the demo and invite our runtime engineer)

Of your proposed times, Tue 2/24 10am PT works best for us. If that slot is still available on your side, please pencil it in and we'll send a calendar invite.

Proposed additions to agenda:
- Live transcript of demo scenarios (sample prompts + expected token throughput)
- Any compliance questions (KMS/HSM, audit logs) from your Marketplace ops team

We'll include a short tech-readout doc in the invite so your team can prep.

Thanks - I'll wait for confirmation.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
